output: html_document
---

```{r}
# =========================================================
# Robustness analysis:
# Within-village ASV sharing under alternative ASV detection thresholds
#
# Detection thresholds:
#   0.01% = 0.0001
#   0.05% = 0.0005
#   0.10% = 0.001  [primary]
#
# Main outputs:
#   robustness/within_village_sharing/tables/
#     - robustness_threshold_summary.csv
#     - robustness_village_intra_inter_by_threshold.csv
#     - robustness_nearest_neighbor_table.csv
#
#   robustness/within_village_sharing/plots/
#     - robustness_overall_intra_vs_inter_by_threshold.png/.svg
#     - robustness_village_delta_by_threshold_boxplot.png/.svg
#     - robustness_intra_gt_inter_counts_by_threshold.png/.svg
#     - robustness_delta_correlation_vs_primary.png/.svg
# =========================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(readr)
  library(scales)
})

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Preconditions
# ---------------------------------------------------------
stopifnot(exists("merged"))
stopifnot(exists("vil_tbl"))
stopifnot(exists("base_theme"))
stopifnot(exists("save_plot_both"))

if (!exists("asv_abund")) {
  if (exists("asv_raw")) {
    sample_cols_tmp <- grep("^S\\d{4}$", names(asv_raw), value = TRUE)
    stopifnot("ASV" %in% names(asv_raw), length(sample_cols_tmp) > 0)
    
    asv_abund <- asv_raw %>%
      select(ASV, all_of(sample_cols_tmp)) %>%
      mutate(across(all_of(sample_cols_tmp), as.numeric)) %>%
      arrange(ASV)
  } else {
    stop("Required object 'asv_abund' is missing, and 'asv_raw' is also unavailable.")
  }
}

stopifnot("ASV" %in% names(asv_abund))
stopifnot(all(c("sampleid", "village_name", "vil_id", "cluster") %in% names(merged)))
stopifnot(all(c("label", "vil_id", "lon", "lat") %in% names(vil_tbl)))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Output folders
# ---------------------------------------------------------
OUTDIR_ROBUST <- "robustness/within_village_sharing"
dir.create(OUTDIR_ROBUST, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR_ROBUST, "tables"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTDIR_ROBUST, "plots"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Parameters
# ---------------------------------------------------------
detection_thresholds <- tibble(
  threshold_label = c("0.01%", "0.05%", "0.1%"),
  threshold_value = c(0.0001, 0.0005, 0.001),
  threshold_order = c(1, 2, 3),
  primary_threshold = c(FALSE, FALSE, TRUE)
)

k_neigh <- 3

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Sample and village metadata
# ---------------------------------------------------------
sample_cols <- setdiff(names(asv_abund), "ASV")

meta_min <- merged %>%
  transmute(
    sampleid = as.character(sampleid),
    village_name = as.character(village_name),
    vil_id = as.character(vil_id),
    cluster = as.character(cluster)
  ) %>%
  filter(sampleid %in% sample_cols) %>%
  distinct()

all_samples <- intersect(meta_min$sampleid, sample_cols)

if (length(all_samples) < 3) {
  stop("Too few shared samples between asv_abund and merged metadata.")
}

vil_list <- split(meta_min$sampleid, meta_min$vil_id)

vil_info <- meta_min %>%
  distinct(vil_id, village_name, cluster) %>%
  left_join(
    meta_min %>%
      count(vil_id, name = "n_samples"),
    by = "vil_id"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    vil_tbl %>%
      transmute(
        vil_id = as.character(vil_id),
        lon = as.numeric(lon),
        lat = as.numeric(lat)
      ),
    by = "vil_id"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(lon), !is.na(lat)) %>%
  arrange(cluster, vil_id)

# keep only villages with coordinates and samples
vil_list <- vil_list[names(vil_list) %in% vil_info$vil_id]

if (length(vil_list) < 3) {
  stop("Too few villages with both samples and coordinates.")
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Haversine distance and k-nearest neighbor table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
haversine_km <- function(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2) {
  R <- 6371.0088
  toRad <- pi / 180
  dlat <- (lat2 - lat1) * toRad
  dlon <- (lon2 - lon1) * toRad
  a <- sin(dlat / 2)^2 +
    cos(lat1 * toRad) * cos(lat2 * toRad) * sin(dlon / 2)^2
  2 * R * asin(pmin(1, sqrt(a)))
}

vn <- vil_info$vil_id
nV <- length(vn)

D_village <- matrix(NA_real_, nV, nV, dimnames = list(vn, vn))

for (i in seq_len(nV)) {
  for (j in seq_len(nV)) {
    D_village[i, j] <- if (i == j) {
      Inf
    } else {
      haversine_km(
        vil_info$lat[i], vil_info$lon[i],
        vil_info$lat[j], vil_info$lon[j]
      )
    }
  }
}

nn_tbl <- lapply(vn, function(v) {
  ord <- order(D_village[v, ], na.last = NA)
  nb <- colnames(D_village)[ord][1:min(k_neigh, length(ord))]
  tibble(
    vil_id = v,
    neigh_vil_id = nb,
    dist_km = D_village[v, nb]
  )
}) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  left_join(
    vil_info %>%
      select(vil_id, village_name, cluster),
    by = "vil_id"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    vil_info %>%
      select(
        neigh_vil_id = vil_id,
        neigh_village_name = village_name,
        neigh_cluster = cluster
      ),
    by = "neigh_vil_id"
  )

write_csv(
  nn_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR_ROBUST, "tables", "robustness_nearest_neighbor_table.csv")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Helper functions
# ---------------------------------------------------------
mean_upper <- function(mat) {
  if (nrow(mat) < 2) return(NA_real_)
  vals <- mat[upper.tri(mat)]
  vals <- vals[is.finite(vals)]
  if (length(vals) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  mean(vals, na.rm = TRUE)
}

get_intra_vals <- function(Jmat, ids) {
  ids <- intersect(ids, rownames(Jmat))
  if (length(ids) < 2) return(numeric(0))
  x <- Jmat[ids, ids, drop = FALSE]
  vals <- x[upper.tri(x)]
  vals <- vals[is.finite(vals)]
  as.numeric(vals)
}

get_between_vals <- function(Jmat, idsA, idsB) {
  idsA <- intersect(idsA, rownames(Jmat))
  idsB <- intersect(idsB, colnames(Jmat))
  if (length(idsA) == 0 || length(idsB) == 0) return(numeric(0))
  x <- Jmat[idsA, idsB, drop = FALSE]
  vals <- as.vector(x)
  vals <- vals[is.finite(vals)]
  as.numeric(vals)
}

mean_between <- function(Jmat, idsA, idsB) {
  vals <- get_between_vals(Jmat, idsA, idsB)
  if (length(vals) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  mean(vals, na.rm = TRUE)
}

fmt_p <- function(p) {
  ifelse(
    is.na(p),
    "NA",
    ifelse(
      p < 0.001,
      formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 2),
      formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 3)
    )
  )
}

calc_jaccard_similarity_from_pa <- function(pa_tbl, samples_use) {
  M <- pa_tbl %>%
    select(ASV, all_of(samples_use)) %>%
    column_to_rownames("ASV") %>%
    as.matrix()
  
  M[is.na(M)] <- 0
  M <- (M > 0) * 1L
  
  # ASV x sample matrix
  Ixy <- crossprod(M)
  k <- colSums(M)
  Uxy <- outer(k, k, "+") - Ixy
  
  J <- Ixy / Uxy
  diag(J) <- NA_real_
  J[Uxy == 0] <- NA_real_
  
  colnames(J) <- rownames(J) <- colnames(M)
  J
}

dist_to_pairwise_long <- function(Jmat) {
  ids <- rownames(Jmat)
  ut <- which(upper.tri(Jmat), arr.ind = TRUE)
  
  tibble(
    sample1 = ids[ut[, 1]],
    sample2 = ids[ut[, 2]],
    jaccard_sim = as.numeric(Jmat[ut])
  ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(jaccard_sim))
}

run_one_threshold <- function(thr_label, thr_value, thr_order, primary_flag) {
  
  message("\nRunning threshold: ", thr_label, " [", thr_value, "]")
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # A) Build P/A table
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  asv_pa_thr <- asv_abund %>%
    select(ASV, all_of(all_samples)) %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(all_samples), ~ as.integer(.x >= thr_value)))
  
  asv_detected_any <- asv_pa_thr %>%
    mutate(any_detected = rowSums(across(all_of(all_samples)), na.rm = TRUE) > 0) %>%
    summarise(n_asvs_detected_any = sum(any_detected)) %>%
    pull(n_asvs_detected_any)
  
  sample_nonzero_tbl <- asv_pa_thr %>%
    select(all_of(all_samples)) %>%
    summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      everything(),
      names_to = "sampleid",
      values_to = "n_detected_asvs"
    ) %>%
    mutate(nonzero_sample = n_detected_asvs > 0)
  
  n_nonzero_samples <- sum(sample_nonzero_tbl$nonzero_sample, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # B) Jaccard similarity
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  J <- calc_jaccard_similarity_from_pa(asv_pa_thr, all_samples)
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # C) Pairwise overall same-village vs different-village
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  pw_thr <- dist_to_pairwise_long(J) %>%
    left_join(
      meta_min,
      by = c("sample1" = "sampleid")
    ) %>%
    rename(
      vil_id1 = vil_id,
      village_name1 = village_name,
      cluster1 = cluster
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      meta_min,
      by = c("sample2" = "sampleid")
    ) %>%
    rename(
      vil_id2 = vil_id,
      village_name2 = village_name,
      cluster2 = cluster
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      same_village = vil_id1 == vil_id2,
      same_cluster = cluster1 == cluster2,
      threshold_label = thr_label,
      threshold_value = thr_value,
      threshold_order = thr_order,
      primary_threshold = primary_flag
    )
  
  overall_pair_summary <- pw_thr %>%
    group_by(threshold_label, threshold_value, threshold_order, primary_threshold, same_village) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_jaccard = mean(jaccard_sim, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_jaccard = median(jaccard_sim, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_jaccard = sd(jaccard_sim, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_pairs = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  overall_wilcox <- tryCatch(
    {
      wilcox.test(jaccard_sim ~ same_village, data = pw_thr)
    },
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  overall_p <- if (is.null(overall_wilcox)) NA_real_ else overall_wilcox$p.value
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # D) Village-wise intra and nearest-neighbor inter
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  intra_df <- tibble(vil_id = names(vil_list)) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      intra = {
        ids <- vil_list[[vil_id]]
        mean_upper(J[ids, ids, drop = FALSE])
      }
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  inter_k_df <- nn_tbl %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      inter_pair = {
        a <- vil_id
        b <- neigh_vil_id
        mean_between(J, vil_list[[a]], vil_list[[b]])
      }
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    group_by(vil_id) %>%
    summarise(
      inter_k3 = mean(inter_pair, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  neigh_list <- split(nn_tbl$neigh_vil_id, nn_tbl$vil_id)
  
  vil_sig_thr <- tibble(vil_id = names(vil_list)) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      intra_vals = list(get_intra_vals(J, vil_list[[vil_id]])),
      inter_vals = list({
        nbs <- neigh_list[[vil_id]]
        if (is.null(nbs) || length(nbs) == 0) {
          numeric(0)
        } else {
          unlist(
            lapply(nbs, function(nb) {
              get_between_vals(J, vil_list[[vil_id]], vil_list[[nb]])
            }),
            use.names = FALSE
          )
        }
      }),
      n_intra_pairs = length(intra_vals),
      n_inter_pairs = length(inter_vals),
      median_intra_pair = if (n_intra_pairs > 0) median(intra_vals) else NA_real_,
      median_inter_pair = if (n_inter_pairs > 0) median(inter_vals) else NA_real_,
      p_value = if (n_intra_pairs > 1 && n_inter_pairs > 1) {
        suppressWarnings(
          wilcox.test(
            unlist(intra_vals),
            unlist(inter_vals),
            alternative = "greater"
          )$p.value
        )
      } else {
        NA_real_
      }
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
      sig_vil = !is.na(p_adj) & p_adj < 0.05
    ) %>%
    select(
      vil_id,
      n_intra_pairs,
      n_inter_pairs,
      median_intra_pair,
      median_inter_pair,
      p_value,
      p_adj,
      sig_vil
    )
  
  vil_cmp_thr <- intra_df %>%
    left_join(inter_k_df, by = "vil_id") %>%
    left_join(vil_info, by = "vil_id") %>%
    left_join(vil_sig_thr, by = "vil_id") %>%
    mutate(
      intra_pct = 100 * intra,
      inter_k3_pct = 100 * inter_k3,
      delta_pct = intra_pct - inter_k3_pct,
      intra_gt_inter = !is.na(delta_pct) & delta_pct > 0,
      threshold_label = thr_label,
      threshold_value = thr_value,
      threshold_order = thr_order,
      primary_threshold = primary_flag
    ) %>%
    select(
      threshold_label,
      threshold_value,
      threshold_order,
      primary_threshold,
      vil_id,
      village_name,
      cluster,
      n_samples,
      lon,
      lat,
      intra,
      inter_k3,
      intra_pct,
      inter_k3_pct,
      delta_pct,
      intra_gt_inter,
      n_intra_pairs,
      n_inter_pairs,
      median_intra_pair,
      median_inter_pair,
      p_value,
      p_adj,
      sig_vil
    )
  
  threshold_summary <- vil_cmp_thr %>%
    summarise(
      threshold_label = thr_label,
      threshold_value = thr_value,
      threshold_order = thr_order,
      primary_threshold = primary_flag,
      n_asvs_detected_any = asv_detected_any,
      n_nonzero_samples = n_nonzero_samples,
      n_villages = n(),
      n_intra_gt_inter = sum(intra_gt_inter, na.rm = TRUE),
      pct_intra_gt_inter = 100 * mean(intra_gt_inter, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_sig_intra_gt_inter = sum(sig_vil & intra_gt_inter, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_intra_pct = mean(intra_pct, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_inter_k3_pct = mean(inter_k3_pct, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_delta_pct = mean(delta_pct, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_delta_pct = median(delta_pct, na.rm = TRUE),
      overall_pairwise_wilcox_p = overall_p,
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  list(
    pw_thr = pw_thr,
    overall_pair_summary = overall_pair_summary,
    vil_cmp_thr = vil_cmp_thr,
    threshold_summary = threshold_summary
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Run all thresholds
# ---------------------------------------------------------
robust_results <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(detection_thresholds)), function(i) {
  run_one_threshold(
    thr_label = detection_thresholds$threshold_label[i],
    thr_value = detection_thresholds$threshold_value[i],
    thr_order = detection_thresholds$threshold_order[i],
    primary_flag = detection_thresholds$primary_threshold[i]
  )
})

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7) Combine result tables
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7) Combine result tables
# ---------------------------------------------------------
robust_pair_summary <- bind_rows(
  lapply(robust_results, function(x) x[["overall_pair_summary"]])
)

robust_village_tbl <- bind_rows(
  lapply(robust_results, function(x) x[["vil_cmp_thr"]])
)

robust_threshold_summary <- bind_rows(
  lapply(robust_results, function(x) x[["threshold_summary"]])
)

# Pairwise table can be very large. Save only if needed.
SAVE_PAIRWISE_LONG <- FALSE

if (SAVE_PAIRWISE_LONG) {
  robust_pw_tbl <- bind_rows(
    lapply(robust_results, function(x) x[["pw_thr"]])
  )
  
  write_csv(
    robust_pw_tbl,
    file.path(OUTDIR_ROBUST, "tables", "robustness_pairwise_jaccard_long_by_threshold.csv")
  )
}


robust_pair_summary <- robust_pair_summary %>%
  mutate(
    threshold_label = factor(
      threshold_label,
      levels = detection_thresholds$threshold_label
    ),
    same_village_label = ifelse(same_village, "Within village", "Between villages")
  )

robust_village_tbl <- robust_village_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    threshold_label = factor(
      threshold_label,
      levels = detection_thresholds$threshold_label
    ),
    cluster = factor(as.character(cluster), levels = if (exists("clu_pal")) names(clu_pal) else sort(unique(as.character(cluster))))
  )

robust_threshold_summary <- robust_threshold_summary %>%
  mutate(
    threshold_label = factor(
      threshold_label,
      levels = detection_thresholds$threshold_label
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(threshold_order)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 8) Correlation of village-level delta with primary threshold
# ---------------------------------------------------------
primary_label <- detection_thresholds %>%
  filter(primary_threshold) %>%
  pull(threshold_label)

primary_delta_tbl <- robust_village_tbl %>%
  filter(as.character(threshold_label) == primary_label) %>%
  select(
    vil_id,
    primary_delta_pct = delta_pct,
    primary_intra_gt_inter = intra_gt_inter,
    primary_sig_vil = sig_vil
  )

robust_delta_correlation_tbl <- robust_village_tbl %>%
  left_join(primary_delta_tbl, by = "vil_id") %>%
  filter(as.character(threshold_label) != primary_label) %>%
  group_by(threshold_label, threshold_value, threshold_order) %>%
  summarise(
    n_villages = sum(!is.na(delta_pct) & !is.na(primary_delta_pct)),
    spearman_rho = suppressWarnings(
      cor(delta_pct, primary_delta_pct, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")
    ),
    pearson_r = suppressWarnings(
      cor(delta_pct, primary_delta_pct, method = "pearson", use = "complete.obs")
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 9) Export tables
# ---------------------------------------------------------
write_csv(
  robust_threshold_summary,
  file.path(OUTDIR_ROBUST, "tables", "robustness_threshold_summary.csv")
)

write_csv(
  robust_pair_summary,
  file.path(OUTDIR_ROBUST, "tables", "robustness_pairwise_summary_by_threshold.csv")
)

write_csv(
  robust_village_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR_ROBUST, "tables", "robustness_village_intra_inter_by_threshold.csv")
)

write_csv(
  robust_delta_correlation_tbl,
  file.path(OUTDIR_ROBUST, "tables", "robustness_delta_correlation_vs_primary.csv")
)

cat("\n===== Robustness threshold summary =====\n")
print(robust_threshold_summary)

cat("\n===== Delta correlation vs primary threshold =====\n")
print(robust_delta_correlation_tbl)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 10) Plot 1: overall within vs between by threshold
# ---------------------------------------------------------
p_overall_robust <- ggplot(
  robust_pair_summary,
  aes(x = threshold_label, y = 100 * mean_jaccard, group = same_village_label)
) +
  geom_line(aes(linetype = same_village_label), linewidth = 0.7, color = "black") +
  geom_point(aes(shape = same_village_label), size = 3, color = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = 100 * (mean_jaccard - sd_jaccard / sqrt(n_pairs)),
      ymax = 100 * (mean_jaccard + sd_jaccard / sqrt(n_pairs))
    ),
    width = 0.08,
    linewidth = 0.4,
    color = "grey40"
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c("Within village" = 16, "Between villages" = 17),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = c("Within village" = "solid", "Between villages" = "dashed"),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Robustness of within-village ASV sharing across detection thresholds",
    subtitle = "Mean pairwise Jaccard similarity calculated from ASV presence/absence matrices",
    x = "ASV detection threshold",
    y = "Mean ASV sharing rate (%)"
  ) +
  base_theme +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

print(p_overall_robust)

save_plot_both(
  p_overall_robust,
  file.path(OUTDIR_ROBUST, "plots", "robustness_overall_intra_vs_inter_by_threshold"),
  width = 8,
  height = 6
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 11) Plot 2: village-level delta by threshold
# ---------------------------------------------------------
p_delta_box <- ggplot(
  robust_village_tbl,
  aes(x = threshold_label, y = delta_pct)
) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.45, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey35") +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.55, outlier.shape = NA, fill = "grey90", color = "black") +
  geom_jitter(
    aes(color = cluster),
    width = 0.12,
    height = 0,
    size = 2.1,
    alpha = 0.75
  ) +
  {
    if (exists("clu_pal")) {
      scale_color_manual(values = clu_pal, drop = FALSE, name = "Cluster")
    } else {
      scale_color_discrete(name = "Cluster")
    }
  } +
  labs(
    title = "Village-level excess ASV sharing across detection thresholds",
    subtitle = expression(Delta~"sharing = within-village sharing - nearest-neighbor inter-village sharing"),
    x = "ASV detection threshold",
    y = expression(Delta~"sharing (%)")
  ) +
  base_theme +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

print(p_delta_box)

save_plot_both(
  p_delta_box,
  file.path(OUTDIR_ROBUST, "plots", "robustness_village_delta_by_threshold_boxplot"),
  width = 8,
  height = 6
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 12) Plot 3: counts of intra > inter and significant villages
# ---------------------------------------------------------
robust_counts_long <- robust_threshold_summary %>%
  select(
    threshold_label,
    n_villages,
    n_intra_gt_inter,
    n_sig_intra_gt_inter
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(n_intra_gt_inter, n_sig_intra_gt_inter),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "n"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    metric = recode(
      metric,
      n_intra_gt_inter = "Intra > inter",
      n_sig_intra_gt_inter = "Significant intra > inter"
    ),
    metric = factor(metric, levels = c("Intra > inter", "Significant intra > inter"))
  )

p_counts <- ggplot(
  robust_counts_long,
  aes(x = threshold_label, y = n, fill = metric)
) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.65),
    width = 0.55,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.25
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = n),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.65),
    vjust = -0.35,
    size = 4
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Intra > inter" = "#D55E00",
      "Significant intra > inter" = "black"
    ),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Number of villages with excess within-village sharing",
    subtitle = "Significant villages are based on one-sided Wilcoxon tests with Benjamini-Hochberg correction",
    x = "ASV detection threshold",
    y = "Number of villages"
  ) +
  base_theme +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

print(p_counts)

save_plot_both(
  p_counts,
  file.path(OUTDIR_ROBUST, "plots", "robustness_intra_gt_inter_counts_by_threshold"),
  width = 8,
  height = 6
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 13) Plot 4: village-level delta correlation vs primary threshold
# ---------------------------------------------------------
delta_scatter_tbl <- robust_village_tbl %>%
  left_join(primary_delta_tbl, by = "vil_id") %>%
  filter(as.character(threshold_label) != primary_label) %>%
  mutate(
    threshold_label = factor(
      threshold_label,
      levels = detection_thresholds$threshold_label[detection_thresholds$threshold_label != primary_label]
    )
  )

corr_label_tbl <- robust_delta_correlation_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    label = paste0(
      "Spearman rho = ",
      formatC(spearman_rho, format = "f", digits = 2)
    )
  )

p_delta_corr <- ggplot(
  delta_scatter_tbl,
  aes(x = primary_delta_pct, y = delta_pct)
) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.35, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.35, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_point(
    aes(color = cluster),
    size = 2.2,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    se = FALSE,
    linewidth = 0.7,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = corr_label_tbl,
    aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = -0.05,
    vjust = 1.2,
    size = 4
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ threshold_label, nrow = 1) +
  {
    if (exists("clu_pal")) {
      scale_color_manual(values = clu_pal, drop = FALSE, name = "Cluster")
    } else {
      scale_color_discrete(name = "Cluster")
    }
  } +
  labs(
    title = "Village-level Δ sharing is stable relative to the primary threshold",
    subtitle = paste0("Primary threshold: ", primary_label),
    x = paste0("Δ sharing at primary threshold ", primary_label, " (%)"),
    y = "Δ sharing at alternative threshold (%)"
  ) +
  base_theme +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

print(p_delta_corr)

save_plot_both(
  p_delta_corr,
  file.path(OUTDIR_ROBUST, "plots", "robustness_delta_correlation_vs_primary"),
  width = 10,
  height = 5.5
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 14) Compact manuscript-facing summary table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
robust_manuscript_summary <- robust_threshold_summary %>%
  transmute(
    Detection_threshold = as.character(threshold_label),
    N_ASVs_detected_at_least_once = n_asvs_detected_any,
    N_nonzero_samples = n_nonzero_samples,
    N_villages = n_villages,
    N_villages_intra_gt_inter = n_intra_gt_inter,
    Percent_villages_intra_gt_inter = pct_intra_gt_inter,
    N_significant_villages_intra_gt_inter = n_sig_intra_gt_inter,
    Mean_within_village_sharing_pct = mean_intra_pct,
    Mean_nearest_neighbor_inter_village_sharing_pct = mean_inter_k3_pct,
    Mean_delta_sharing_pct = mean_delta_pct,
    Median_delta_sharing_pct = median_delta_pct,
    Overall_pairwise_Wilcoxon_P = overall_pairwise_wilcox_p
  )

write_csv(
  robust_manuscript_summary,
  file.path(OUTDIR_ROBUST, "tables", "robustness_manuscript_summary.csv")
)

cat("\n===== Manuscript-facing robustness summary =====\n")
print(robust_manuscript_summary)
```
